name: Harvest
one_liner: Harvest offers a RESTful API with OAuth2 and Personal Access Tokens for accessing time tracking, invoicing, and project data.
auth_notes: Supports Personal Access Tokens and OAuth2 flows (Authorization Code and Implicit).
access_notes: API access is available to all Harvest accounts, including free and trial.

evidence.snippet: The Harvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection lets you work with your Harvest data through an AI assistant, using plain language instead of clicking through the app.
Remote MCP server URL to: https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp
The first step involves obtaining a Personal Access Token via your Harvest ID account.
